write a mail.reply: Opening Gmail compose window. What is the message and who should I send it to?

jarvis play.command: osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to execute front window's active tab javascript "document.querySelector(\"video\").play()"'

jarvis stop.command: osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to execute front window's active tab javascript "document.querySelector(\"video\").pause()"'

jarvis pause.command: osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to execute front window's active tab javascript "document.querySelector(\"video\").pause()"'

matrix mode.command: open -a Terminal && osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "/bin/bash -c \"$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)\" && brew install cmatrix && cmatrix"'
matrix mode.reply: Entering matrix mode and installing cmatrix if needed.

who are you.command: say "I am JARVIS, an AI engine created by AskDeepakAI."
who are you.reply: I'm JARVIS, an AI engine created by AskDeepakAI.

jarvis,my clean desktop.reply: I've moved all your current desktop files into a new folder named "Desktop data".

dark mode.command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to true'

light mode.command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to false'

stealth mode.command: osascript -e 'set volume output muted true' && brightness 0.1
stealth mode.reply: Activating stealth mode. Speakers muted and brightness lowered.
